tokens.name: plum
tokens.usage: Primary brand colour. Headings, primary buttons (white text 12.9:1), active nav, the left petal of the logo.

tokens.name: on-plum
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on a plum fill.

tokens.name: orchid
tokens.usage: Secondary brand hue. Focus rings, links, gradient partner of plum on hero cards (white text 7.0:1).

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: Action and warmth: SOS button, the right petal of the logo, highlights. Fill only; put ink text on it (5.9:1), white only at 24px+ (2.95:1). Never body text.

tokens.name: coral-text
tokens.usage: Coral when it must be text on pearl or white (4.9:1): inline links like 'See all', counters.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Care and health: cycle tracker, verified professionals, success. Icons and large fills; 4.19:1 with white is below AA for small text, use teal-deep for buttons.

tokens.name: teal-deep
tokens.usage: Teal buttons and teal text on light grounds (white text 6.3:1).

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Star ratings, celebrations, the pearl ring. Decorative and icons only, never text on light grounds.

tokens.name: pearl
tokens.usage: Page background in the app and portals.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, dialogs and inputs on pearl.

tokens.name: lilac
tokens.usage: Quiet tint: chips, selected rows, plum badges' ground.

tokens.name: coral-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for coral badges and period days on the cycle calendar.

tokens.name: teal-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for teal badges, hygiene checklist done state, professional avatars.

tokens.name: gold-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for celebration banners and pending badges (text #8A5A00).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text on pearl and card (16.3:1).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, timestamps (5.5:1 on pearl).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders of cards, inputs and table rows.

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: Errors, strikes, destructive actions such as Log out confirm. White text is 4.4:1, use bold 14px+ on it.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip padding, gaps inside a row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gaps between list items.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile, screen gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on web, section gaps.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons (36px), icon tiles, chips with text.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons (44 and 54px) and inputs, on mobile and web alike.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets and dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Badges, filter chips, avatars, toggles.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Resting cards. One soft plum-tinted lift, never stacked.

tokens.name: button-lg
tokens.usage: Primary action at the bottom of a mobile screen.

tokens.name: button-md
tokens.usage: Default button height and minimum touch target.

tokens.name: button-sm
tokens.usage: Inline actions in rows (Done, Start).

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Inline icons beside text.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Icons in buttons and the bottom nav.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Icons inside feature tiles.
